title: Mike LaFleur: Marvin Harrison Jr. situation wasn't a distraction, not why we didn't play well

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Mike LaFleur: Marvin Harrison Jr. situation wasn't a distraction, not why we didn't play well
sources.description: Word that the Cardinals were planning to trade wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. broke on Saturday morning and word that they had agreed to a deal with the Texans came just as the Cardinals were starting Sunday's game against the Lions.
